# NIMH Social Anxiety Overview

NIMH describes social anxiety disorder as a persistent fear of social situations that may involve scrutiny or judgment. Its public overview notes that support can include psychotherapy such as CBT, and explains exposure therapy as a CBT approach that gradually helps people face feared situations.

For this project, the page is used as a public educational resource, not as a diagnostic tool. It supports explaining why someone might seek reliable information or real-world support when social fear is persistent or disruptive.

## 中文检索摘要

这是美国国家心理健康研究所 NIMH 提供的社交焦虑公共科普页面，介绍持续的社交恐惧、对审视或评价的担心，以及 CBT、渐进式面对害怕场景等常见支持方式。项目只把它作为教育性资料，不依据页面内容判断用户是否患有某种疾病。

适用查询包括：社交焦虑科普、持续害怕社交评价、什么时候寻求现实支持、CBT 与渐进式练习的公共介绍。
